title: JP Morgan funds Tesla's Wardenclyffe wireless energy work

tellings.quote: and received funding from JP Morgan to work on this stuff at Warden Cliff and it was all about wireless energy transmission
even beyond that, he was talking about wireless instantaneous transmission and his experiments at Wardenclyffe that were sponsored by J.P. Morgan.
tellings.difference: Calls it wireless instantaneous transmission rather than wireless energy transmission.
tellings.link_reason: Same story: Tesla's wireless transmission work at Wardenclyffe, paid for by J.P. Morgan.

as_told.title: Tesla's wireless transmission experiments at Wardenclyffe

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla is said to have got money from the banker J.P. Morgan for experiments at Wardenclyffe, his research site in New York, on sending power through the air without wires. Michels tells this himself in two episodes without naming a source. In one he calls it wireless energy transmission, and in the other "wireless instantaneous transmission". He tells it as an example of Tesla's work that he believes was ahead of its time and may still be hidden.
